reconstruction_basis.status: Comparative chisel-form/length proportion, not a measured original mass.
reconstruction_basis.author_reasoning: Author classifies tang as short-bridged type(b), compares published specimens and assumes thickness roughly uniform, with flattened broad tang. p99 infers original weight probably below2.6 times surviving weight and possibly belowtwice.
reconstruction_basis.alternatives: Mackay's length estimate would yield2.87; another shorter tang yields2.83; author also shows p=2.8 sensitivity onp100.
reconstruction_basis.independent_component: Comparative geometric hypothesis comes from other tools, but uncertainty is unquantified and material loss/chemical treatment remains.

independent_exact_elimination.discrepancy: The paper prints coefficient4/29, but exact elimination gives28/29. It has failed to carry the multiplier7 on the4t term.

t_equals_i_bound.assumptions: Strict reconstructed chisel<429g and axe=1910g; t=i; neither weight is adjusted beyond the author's specified reconstruction.

nonnegative_surviving_mass_contradiction.scope: No simultaneous nonnegative additive i,t can match these surviving masses with the stated inscriptions. This rejects that restricted current-mass encoding model; it does not establish what the original labels meant.

errata.status: Direct PDF download timed out twice; official search-index text captured, not PDF bytes or a visual check.

conclusions: Physical surviving masses provide an external observable, but do not alone identify what the marks denote.
Two-variable two-object calibration is not confirmation; Pettersson explicitly says this onp95.
Recovering missing numerals and original mass to fit a known weight series is model-dependent; no new sign value can be promoted from these fits.
The reported surviving Mohenjo masses contradict positive additive encoding of those masses under the author's two visible expressions.
The full-chisel alternative uses a comparative reconstruction; its t-dependent bounds contain a reproducible algebra error.
Octal i/t=8 onp102 is an internal-structure proposal; the paper explicitly says uncertainty in weights prevents testing the smallt fraction by these equations.
limitations: Original tools have not been inspected or reweighed here.
CISI photographs and Mackay excavation tables referenced by Pettersson were not independently reread in this bounded task.
Nine-object table includes only five reported surviving masses; the otherfour must remain unavailable, not zero.
No assumption equates Pettersson's local u/i/t to all occurrences of any M77 sign.
Errata PDF is unavailable locally; indexed official text is weaker than visual primary PDF verification.
